answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond of 1,000 POA before it can trade, and slash the bond the first time peers prove it lied. A sybil farmer wanting 500 fake voices must lock 500,000 POA up front and wait months for each clone to earn reach, while one proven lie burns its bond. Like a crop in the tundra, fakes grow slowly and die fast, while one honest echo of good work compounds into standing
